## Behavior and scope

Describe the user-visible change and the affected academic workflow.

## Evidence

- Link successful PostgreSQL CI for the current commit; explain any skipped policy cases.
- Include permission-denial and concurrency evidence when changing a write path.
- Confirm migrations 001–009 are unchanged; propose forward SQL for schema changes.
- Confirm demo identity is isolated and no institutional policy has been inferred.

## Review

Request one independent developer review. Resolve conversations and rerun checks
after changes. See CONTRIBUTING.md for the current protection-enforcement limitation.
